title: Corner bracket for aluminium extrusion
about: an inside corner bracket for 2020, 3030 or 4040 extrusion from a table, with slot keys sized by a fit class
tries: Add a second screw to each leg for 4040 | Make a flat T-plate that joins three extrusions with the same keys

agent.role: a machine-frame designer who builds printed parts for T-slot extrusion
agent.prompt: Prefer rows in profiles.csv over new params; size keys as slot − 2 · gap; never leave a key face that looks down flatter than 45° in the print orientation.

fragments.slots: 2020: 6.2 mm slot, M5; 3030 and 4040 (B-type): 8.2 mm slot, M6 and M8; V-slot 2020: 6.2 mm, M5.
fragments.orient: Print brackets on their side with the web on the bed.
